_about: Strings that must not appear in user-visible copy (source string literals and rendered text) of the Knack dashboard and desktop renderers. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words. The allow-list at the bottom is the only place the old name may remain: internal identifiers, env names, file names, storage keys. See docs/KNACK_UX.md section 5 and rule 6.
visible_words_note: Whole word, any case, in visible text and aria text. The owner removed the word demo from every visible string (docs/KNACK_UX.md), and on 8 Nov 2026 (D57) the words synthetic and simulated too: a screen says concretely where numbers come from (generators we wrote, planted example learners, language-model participants, example people made for this build) and carries no tag, chip or label of any wording that says the data was generated or made up (clarified the same night: the one plain sentence is inside the closed About this data, and Evidence has a Measured on column for reviewers). Data enums and identifiers (origin: synthetic) are not copy and stay. apps/dashboard/scripts/check-words.mjs checks the same words on the rendered page and stays in the build. On 8 Nov 2026 (05:00, owner) the family of phrases that say or imply that what is on screen is not real was added: example data, example week, sample data, stand-in, stand in, not real workers, for this build, and fixture as a visible word. No pill, chip, badge, banner, status line, tooltip, aria label, toast or sentence says them, on any screen. The one exemption is the Evidence page (admin More) and the report it reads: its Measured on column, limitations and findings state how each evaluation result was obtained, so removing them would make the research claims false (see EVIDENCE_PAGE in apps/dashboard/src/lib/words.test.ts).

visible_old_name.scope: text nodes, aria-label, alt, placeholder, document.title, window and notification titles, tray labels

jargon_note: Allowed inside Details, in Evidence and on Admin screens where the term is the established name; never in a worker's default view.
mono_capitals: text-transform: uppercase is allowed only on chart axes and the work ribbon (.t-label--mono, .svg-text)
